name: Mashed Indian Curry Vegetable Stew with Buttered Rolls (Pav Bhaji)

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium red potatoes
3 medium carrots
2 green bell peppers
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
6 tomatoes
1 ½ limes
2 small bunches cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Peel and small dice potatoes and carrots. Seed and small dice bell peppers. Transfer veggies to a large pot.

Add broth, sugar, and salt to the pot; stir to combine, then scrape down the edges of the pot so that veggies are submerged. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat; reduce heat to medium and simmer until potatoes and carrots are fork-tender, 15-17 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1183 ml chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ tsp brown sugar
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat another large pot over medium heat.
While the pot heats up, peel and small dice onions.
Once the pot is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the onion (reserving a handful for garnish) and cook, stirring occasionally, until it begins to soften, 5-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince ginger and garlic; add both to the pot with the onion. Continue to cook, stirring often, until soft and fragrant, about 3 minutes.

Add tomatoes, additional broth, peas, tomato paste, and spices to the pot with the onion. Continue to cook, stirring often, until sauce thickens and peas are heated through, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
355 ml chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ cups frozen peas
6 tbsp tomato paste
2 tbsp curry powder
2 tbsp chili powder
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp cinnamon, ground
3 pinch cayenne pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the potatoes and carrots are tender, remove from heat. Use a potato masher to gently crush the veggies, forming a textured mash. Transfer the tomato sauce to the pot with the potatoes and mash once more to combine.
Return veggie mash to the stove over medium-high heat. Continue to cook, stirring often, until slightly thickened, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, cut limes into wedges and set aside.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add cilantro to the vegetable mash (reserving a handful for garnish) and stir to combine. Remove from heat.
Toast rolls if desired, and spread with butter.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 whole grain buns or rolls
3 tbsp butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Divide veggie mash between plates and top with more butter. Serve with onion, cilantro, lime wedges, and buttered rolls. Enjoy!
